description: Source code for RawInputDStream and RawNetworkReceiver classes in Spark Streaming, handling network input streams of serialized objects.

classes.name: RawInputDStream
classes.description: A specialized input stream in Spark Streaming that reads serialized object blocks from a network address and inserts them into the block store.

classes.name: RawNetworkReceiver
classes.description: A receiver that connects to a network socket, reads length-prefixed data blocks, and stores them for Spark Streaming processing.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns a new RawNetworkReceiver instance configured with host, port, and storage level.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection, starts a thread to push data into Spark, and continuously reads length-prefixed data blocks from the network.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Interrupts the data pushing thread to stop the receiver.

methods.name: readFully
methods.description: Reads data fully from a channel into a ByteBuffer until the buffer is filled or end of stream.
